subject: design-technology
title: Joining & Finishing
welcome_lead: Glue, screws, sanding and surface finishes.
meta_desc: KS3 D&T: joining methods, sanding, finishing.
final_note: Joining and finishing turn parts into product.

walkthroughs.body_html: Wood joining: PVA glue (water-based, strong), screws (removable, strong), nails (quick, less strong). Metal joining: rivets, soldering, welding.
Sandpaper has grits — low numbers (40-80) are coarse, high (240+) are fine. Start coarse to shape, finish fine for a smooth surface. Always sand with the grain.
Finishes protect and decorate. Paint covers with colour. Varnish stays clear, showing grain. Wax gives a soft sheen. Always finish in dust-free air.
